mainQuests.title: The Ledger of the Lost Town
mainQuests.description: You wake up in a village where memory is currency. 'To see the path ahead, you must first record where you stand.'

objectives.text: Talk to Chronicler Daniel in Starting Village
Defeat the Debt Gnomes in the Outskirts

mainQuests.title: Rats in the Granary
mainQuests.description: The Stablemaster swears something is nibbling the village's recorded stores. Every missing sack is an unbalanced line.

objectives.text: Ask the Stablemaster what has gone missing
Exterminate the Interest Imp in the Outskirts

mainQuests.title: The Toll of the Glutton
mainQuests.description: Gorgos the Swallower blocks the bridge. He demands a 'memory toll' from all travelers.

objectives.text: Explore Copper Town Plaza
Slay Gorgos the Swallower

mainQuests.title: The Copper Skimmer
mainQuests.description: The Copper Smith's tallies keep coming up short. A wraith is skimming a coin from every transaction in the marshes.

objectives.text: Compare ledgers with the Copper Smith
Destroy the Ledger Wraith haunting the marshes

mainQuests.title: The Gilded Cage
mainQuests.description: Silver City glitters, but its vaults whisper of a djinn that grants wishes against your future earnings.

objectives.text: Reach the spires of Silver City
Consult the High Banker about the missing reserves
Banish the Inflation Djinn

mainQuests.title: The Vault of Whispers
mainQuests.description: Silver City's lower vault hums with a debt no one will claim. Trace the whispers to their source before they become a roar.

objectives.text: Question the Guild Master about the sealed accounts
Have the High Banker unlock the ledger of debts
Slay the Overdraft Ogre guarding the vault

mainQuests.title: The Debt Everlasting
mainQuests.description: At the heart of the Iron Citadel, a golem of compounding interest guards the final page of the ledger.

objectives.text: March on the Iron Citadel
Receive Commander Fortis's battle plan
Shatter the Compound Golem

mainQuests.title: The Ledger's Last Seal
mainQuests.description: One page of the great ledger remains unwritten. The Iron Citadel's keepers guard the final seal — and something older guards them.

objectives.text: Retrieve the archive key from the Grand Archivist
Get Commander Fortis to lower the iron gate
Vanquish the Ledger Wraith of the last seal
